verdict.rationale: Bulk operations on many items are a fair question for an authenticator or password manager, so the axis applies. The pack shows only importing from other apps, export/sync files and per-token customization, which are migration and adjacent features, not a documented way to act on many items at once. The llms.txt also states 'Public API: None', so there is no programmatic route to bulk actions either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
